text: Mum called. I got irritated over nothing and hung up. idk, just off.
clarification: I've felt irritated, guilty and numb, with a tightness in my chest, for a few weeks.

text: Booked my first psychiatry appointment. I want them to understand it's not just stress, but every time I try to explain it the words disappear.
Ate dinner standing in the kitchen again. Didn't really taste anything.
